notes.title: v2.3: Optimized Sudoku Single and Multiple Selection
notes.content:
1. In marking mode, if the selected cell contains a confirmed number, it will be displayed as a single selection, making it easier for users to play Sudoku.
2. Improved the start interface and fixed an occasional issue where the controller could not enter a certain level.

notes.title: V2.2 Added More Killer Sudoku Levels and Optimized the Gaming Experience.
notes.content:
1. Added 30 Killer Sudoku levels, including 10 easy, 10 medium, and 10 hard levels.
2. Stored cage candidate number markings.
3. Optimized the arrangement of cage candidate numbers.
4. Fixed a bug with quick marking of candidate numbers.
5. Removed the blue selection box toggle feature to enhance the interface's aesthetic appeal.

notes.title: v2.0: Added Killer Sudoku
notes.content:
1. Introduced a new type of Killer Sudoku.
2. Added two new types of Sudoku notes, making gameplay more convenient and professional.
3. Optimized the display of controller icons, which now only appear when a controller is connected.
4. Implemented a multi-select feature for cells, allowing users to select multiple consecutive cells at once.

For those experiencing issues with saved files, please send the file located at:
C:\Users\wxmwo\AppData\LocalLow\twwxm\Minimalist Sudoku\SaveData.json
to the email address: tianwangwxm@163.com. I will address the issue within approximately 24 hours.

notes.title: v1.1： Added a More Challenging "Master" Level Stage
notes.content:
Added 25 "Master" level difficulty stages.

As this is my first time developing an independent game, I am not entirely sure which aspects of the game are well-executed and which areas need improvement. I warmly welcome players to provide feedback and suggestions, which will be invaluable for future updates and enhancements to the game. Thank you!
